de.name: Saltbox Hill

ro.name: Saltbox Hill

ro.name: Valea Biggin Hill

en.name: St George's RAF Chapel of Remembrance
en.text: A moving memorial chapel built in 1951 to commemorate the airmen who died flying from the Biggin Hill Sector.

en.name: Biggin Hill Heritage Hangar
en.text: A restoration facility and museum housing a large collection of airworthy Spitfires and other historic aircraft.

en.name: St Mark's Church
en.text: Known as the 'Moving Church', it was built using materials from a demolished church in North Peckham in the 1950s.

en.name: Leaves Green
en.text: A scenic common area and village green on the edge of Biggin Hill, offering a traditional rural atmosphere.

en.name: Saltbox Hill
en.text: A steep hill and Site of Special Scientific Interest noted for its chalk grassland and rare plant species.

en.name: Biggin Hill Memorial Library
en.text: A modern library and community hub that also serves as a local history resource and information center.

en.name: Aperfield Village Green
en.text: A historic green space marking the site of the ancient manor of Aperfield, mentioned in the Domesday Book.

en.name: Darwin's Path (Downe Bank)
en.text: Located nearby, these woods were frequented by Charles Darwin for his studies of orchids and insects.

en.name: Biggin Hill Valley
en.text: A residential area known for its unique layout and timber-framed bungalows built in the early 20th century.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Biggin Hill liegt markant auf einem der höchsten Punkte der North Downs im London Borough of Bromley. Weltweite Berühmtheit erlangte der Ort durch den Flugplatz RAF Biggin Hill, der während des Zweiten Weltkriegs, insbesondere während der Luftschlacht um England im Jahr 1940, eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Verteidigung Londons spielte. Von hier aus starteten die legendären Spitfire- und Hurricane-Jäger gegen die Angriffe der Luftwaffe. Heute ist der Flugplatz ein geschäftiger Zivilflughafen für Privatjets und beherbergt das 'Biggin Hill Memorial Museum', das die bewegte Geschichte der Station und der dort stationierten Piloten dokumentiert. Die Stadt selbst entwickelte sich erst im 20. Jahrhundert von einem kleinen Weiler zu einem gefragten Wohnort. Viele Häuser wurden ursprünglich als Wochenendhäuser für Londoner gebaut, die die frische Luft der Downs suchten. Aufgrund seiner Höhenlage bietet Biggin Hill weite Ausblicke über die umliegende Landschaft von Kent. Trotz der Nähe zur Metropole hat sich der Ort einen eigenständigen, fast ländlichen Charakter bewahrt, der stark von seiner Identität als 'Fliegerstadt' geprägt ist.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: Biggin Hill London déli peremén, Bromley kerületében található, és a repülés történetének egyik szentélye. A város neve elválaszthatatlanul összefonódott a RAF Biggin Hill katonai repülőtérrel, amely a II. világháború során a brit légvédelem legfontosabb bástyája volt. Winston Churchill nevezte a bázis pilótáit a 'keveseknek', akik megmentették a nemzetet. A repülőtér ma is működik, polgári és üzleti célokat szolgál, de történelmi emlékezetét a Szent György Emlékkápolna és a mellette lévő múzeum őrzi. A település földrajzilag különleges, mivel ez Nagy-London legmagasabban fekvő lakott területe, mintegy 180 méterrel a tengerszint felett. A városiasodás a 20. század elején indult meg, eredetileg kertvárosi jellegű parcellázásokkal. A lakók büszkék a közösségi szellemre és a környék természetközeli állapotára, hiszen a North Downs dombvidéke kiváló túrázási lehetőségeket kínál. Az éves légiparádék évtizedekig tömegeket vonzottak a városba, és bár a formátum változott, a repülés iránti szenvedély ma is áthatja Biggin Hill mindennapjait.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Biggin Hill este o așezare unică situată pe creasta North Downs, în districtul Bromley, fiind cel mai înalt punct din regiunea Londrei Mari. Orașul a intrat în istoria universală datorită aerodromului său militar, RAF Biggin Hill, care a fost centrul nervos al apărării aeriene britanice în timpul Bătăliei Angliei din 1940. Sacrificiul piloților care au decolat de aici pentru a intercepta avioanele inamice este comemorat astăzi prin monumente impresionante și prin Muzeul Memorial Biggin Hill. În afara patrimoniului său militar, orașul este o zonă rezidențială liniștită, care a crescut semnificativ în secolul XX, transformându-se dintr-un mic sat într-o comunitate prosperă. Arhitectura este variată, incluzând case din perioada interbelică și dezvoltări moderne, toate beneficiind de aerul curat și de vederile panoramice oferite de altitudinea ridicată. Economia locală este încă strâns legată de activitățile aeroportuare, care s-au diversificat spre aviația de afaceri și întreținerea aeronavelor. Biggin Hill oferă un echilibru perfect între moștenirea istorică de prestigiu și calitatea vieții într-un mediu natural protejat.
descriptionAdvanced.en: Biggin Hill is a prominent hilltop town in the London Borough of Bromley, situated on the North Downs. It is internationally recognised primarily for its airfield, RAF Biggin Hill, which served as one of the most vital fighter bases during the Second World War. As a frontline station during the Battle of Britain, it was instrumental in protecting London from aerial assault, a role that earned it a place of honour in British military history. The Biggin Hill Memorial Museum and the St George's RAF Chapel of Remembrance stand today as poignant tributes to the pilots and personnel stationed there. Geographically, at approximately 180 metres above sea level, it is the highest residential part of Greater London, offering expansive views over the Kent countryside. The town's development was largely a 20th-century phenomenon, evolving from a rural hamlet into a suburban community favoured for its hilltop setting and fresh air. Today, while the airfield operates as a major business aviation hub, the town retains a distinct character, blending suburban convenience with a strong sense of pride in its heroic aviation legacy.

de.q: Was kann man am Flugplatz Biggin Hill besichtigen?
de.a: Das Biggin Hill Memorial Museum und die Gedenkkapelle sind öffentlich zugänglich.

de.q: Warum ist Biggin Hill historisch so wichtig?
de.a: Es war ein Schlüsselstützpunkt der RAF in der Luftschlacht um England.

de.q: Kann man von Biggin Hill aus kommerziell fliegen?
de.a: Nein, es ist ein Flughafen für Privatjets und die allgemeine Luftfahrt.

de.q: Wie weit ist es bis zum Zentrum von London?
de.a: Es liegt etwa 23 Kilometer südlich der Londoner City.

ro.q: Ce se poate vedea la Muzeul Memorial Biggin Hill?
ro.a: Artefacte militare, avioane de epocă și expoziții despre Bătălia Angliei.

ro.q: Este aeroportul încă folosit de armată?
ro.a: Nu, acum este în principal un aeroport civil pentru zboruri private.

ro.q: Cum se ajunge din Londra la Biggin Hill?
ro.a: Prin servicii de autobuz de la stațiile de tren Bromley South sau Orpington.

ro.q: Ce activități în aer liber se pot face în zonă?
ro.a: Drumeții și ciclism pe traseele din North Downs.

en.q: What is there to see at the airfield?
en.a: The Biggin Hill Memorial Museum and the historic RAF Chapel are the main attractions.

en.q: Why is Biggin Hill called a 'fighter station'?
en.a: It was a primary base for fighter aircraft like the Spitfire during WWII.

en.q: Is Biggin Hill in London or Kent?
en.a: It is officially in the London Borough of Bromley, on the border with Kent.

en.q: Can the public fly from Biggin Hill Airport?
en.a: It is mainly restricted to private charter flights and business aviation.
